01.name: The Creative
01.description: A powerful white cat poised on a high moonlit roof as golden wind spirals upward into a vast indigo sky, clouds opening like a gate of pure potential, elegant posture, sovereign energy.

02.name: The Receptive
02.description: A gentle dark cat resting in a mossy garden beneath broad earth-colored leaves, moonlight pooling softly around stones and roots. It evokes patience, devotion, and fertile quiet.

03.name: Difficulty at the Beginning
03.description: A small kitten pushing through tangled reeds after rain, tiny paws on wet stones, distant lanterns glowing through storm mist, fragile beginnings meeting confusion with courage.

04.name: Youthful Folly
04.description: A curious kitten peering into a clear mountain spring, its reflection touched by drifting maple leaves and pale moonlight, innocence asking to be taught by stillness.

05.name: Waiting
05.description: A patient cat sitting under a temple eave while rain falls in silver threads, a covered bowl of tea steaming nearby, distant clouds slowly parting, trust in timing.

06.name: Conflict
06.description: Two elegant cats facing each other across a narrow bridge over dark water, moonlight divided by passing clouds, tense but restrained, the need for clarity before crossing.

07.name: The Army
07.description: A disciplined procession of cats moving through bamboo at dawn, led by one calm elder cat with a small lantern, quiet order, loyalty, and shared purpose without aggression.

08.name: Holding Together
08.description: Several cats gathered around a still moonlit pond where small streams meet, their reflections forming one quiet circle, belonging, sincerity, and mutual support.

09.name: Small Taming
09.description: A nimble cat carefully holding a fluttering ribbon in a soft breeze, clouds gathering but not yet raining, small restraint guiding restless energy.

10.name: Treading
10.description: A composed cat stepping lightly across the tail of a sleeping tiger painted like a mountain spirit, moonlit grass bending under careful paws, danger met with grace and manners.

11.name: Peace
11.description: A white cat and a black cat resting together beneath blooming plum branches, warm lantern light rising from below as cool moonlight descends from above, harmony between heaven and earth.

12.name: Standstill
12.description: A lone cat sitting before a closed wooden gate in winter fog, lanterns dim behind the wall, snow beginning to gather, separation, preservation, and the wisdom of not forcing entry.

13.name: Fellowship
13.description: Cats from different rooftops meeting beneath a wide open sky, lanterns shared along a village lane, clear air, common purpose, and kinship beyond territory.

14.name: Great Possession
14.description: A golden-eyed cat seated beside a treasure bowl filled with moonlit rice, coins, seeds, and tiny bells, abundance held with dignity and responsibility.

15.name: Modesty
15.description: A humble cat sweeping fallen leaves from a small mountain shrine at dawn, only clean stones, mist, and a low bow of quiet competence.

16.name: Enthusiasm
16.description: Playful cats preparing a village festival courtyard, lanterns swaying before summer thunder, ribbons lifting in wind, energy gathering before the first drumbeat.

17.name: Following
17.description: A cat walking beside a winding river at dusk, following floating lanterns around each bend rather than forcing a straight path, trust in movement and response.

18.name: Work on What Has Been Spoiled
18.description: A determined cat repairing an old garden gate overgrown with vines, pawprints in dust, tools and gold motes around rotting wood, neglect becoming care.

19.name: Approach
19.description: A wise elder cat descending temple steps toward a younger cat waiting below, spring mist lifting, lanterns brightening one by one, benevolent arrival and open guidance.

20.name: Contemplation
20.description: A cat seated on a high tiled roof at sunset, watching gardens, laundry lines, footpaths, and clouds arrange themselves into one living pattern, quiet observation.

21.name: Biting Through
21.description: A sharp-eyed cat biting through a knotted cord stretched across a doorway, sparks of gold breaking from the knot, decisive justice and obstruction removed.

22.name: Grace
22.description: A graceful cat beneath cherry blossoms beside a lacquered paper lantern, beauty simple and restrained, moonlight revealing elegance without vanity.

23.name: Splitting Apart
23.description: A cat perched on a weathered cliffside porch as old roof tiles loosen and fall into fog below, the structure thinning, release and caution at the edge.

24.name: Return
24.description: A cat following its own pawprints back through fresh snow toward a small warm doorway, the first green sprout showing near the path, renewal after stillness.

25.name: Innocence
25.description: A cat leaping through tall grass under a sudden clear sky, no collar, no burden, only natural movement and bright wind, sincerity without agenda.

26.name: Great Taming
26.description: A strong cat seated before a mountain storehouse of scrolls, seeds, and bells, holding great energy in stillness, disciplined power waiting for the right time.

27.name: Nourishment
27.description: A cat beside a humble kitchen hearth watching steam rise from a rice bowl, herbs hanging from beams, the sacredness of what is taken in and offered out.

28.name: Great Preponderance
28.description: A cat crossing a sagging wooden beam above floodwater, heavy blossoms bending the branch overhead, too much weight requiring extraordinary balance.

29.name: The Abyss
29.description: A black cat moving along wet stones inside a moonlit ravine, water rushing on both sides, danger repeated yet navigable through calm attention.

30.name: Radiance
30.description: Two cats sitting beside twin lanterns during a rainy evening, reflections glowing in dark window glass, clarity, attachment, and warmth illuminating ordinary things.

31.name: Influence
31.description: Two cats quietly noticing each other across a moonlit garden, one paw disturbing a pond and the ripple reaching the other side, gentle attraction and mutual response.

32.name: Duration
32.description: An old cat and a young cat walking the same stone path under changing seasons shown in drifting leaves and blossoms, steadiness through time.

33.name: Retreat
33.description: A cat slipping quietly into mountain bamboo as dawn light rises behind pursuing shadows, withdrawal as wisdom, dignity, and self-preservation.

34.name: Great Power
34.description: A muscular cat standing in a windy field holding a kite string as storm clouds gather, strength guided by restraint, power that must not become force.

35.name: Progress
35.description: A bright cat climbing sunlit palace steps at morning, banners stirring gently, the village below waking, recognition and forward movement with humility.

36.name: Darkening of the Light
36.description: A luminous-eyed cat hiding its glow beneath a woven basket during a harsh night patrol, inner light protected until danger passes.

37.name: The Family
37.description: A household of cats gathered in a warm kitchen, bowls, herbs, folded cloth, and lanterns in ordered harmony, care, roles, and belonging within a lived-in home.

38.name: Opposition
38.description: Two cats on opposite sides of a rooftop ridge at sunset, one in warm gold light and one in blue shadow, both held by the same sky, difference without exile.

39.name: Obstruction
39.description: A cat paused before a flooded mountain path blocked by fallen branches, noticing a small side trail glowing through fog, difficulty redirecting attention.

40.name: Deliverance
40.description: A cat shaking rain from its fur as storm clouds break over a mountain village, loose cords falling away from a gate, release after tension.

41.name: Decrease
41.description: A cat gently pushing one coin, one rice grain, and one flower petal into a small offering bowl, less becoming meaningful, simplification and sincerity.

42.name: Increase
42.description: A cat planting seeds beside a riverbank as spring wind scatters golden leaves upstream and downstream, generosity multiplying through motion.

43.name: Breakthrough
43.description: A resolute cat standing on a rooftop at dawn as a torn storm cloud opens into clear light, truth announced with courage but not cruelty.

44.name: Coming to Meet
44.description: A cat encountering a sudden foxfire-like glow at a crossroads under willow branches, beautiful, magnetic, and potentially disruptive, the need for discernment.

45.name: Gathering Together
45.description: Many cats assembling in a lantern-lit courtyard around a central drum and offering table, community, remembrance, and shared focus gathering energy.

46.name: Pushing Upward
46.description: A cat carrying a tiny sapling up moss-covered stone steps toward sunrise, patient ascent, steady effort, and growth that cannot be rushed.

47.name: Oppression
47.description: A tired cat at the bottom of a dry well looking up at a circle of stars, empty bucket, worn stones, and one faint lantern, limitation revealing inner endurance.

48.name: The Well
48.description: Cats gathered around an ancient stone well beneath cedar trees, water reflecting the moon without being owned, shared nourishment and timeless source.

49.name: Revolution
49.description: A cat shedding an old patterned collar beside a firelit dye vat, autumn leaves swirling like banners, transformation at the proper time.

50.name: The Cauldron
50.description: A cat watching a bronze cauldron steam in a temple kitchen, herbs, sparks, and moonlit incense rising together, refinement, culture, and transformation through care.

51.name: The Arousing
51.description: A startled cat leaping as thunder cracks above a shrine gate, lanterns trembling but not falling, shock awakening attention and life force.

52.name: Keeping Still
52.description: A cat sitting motionless on a mountain stone, tail wrapped neatly, mist moving while the cat remains utterly calm, stillness as strength.

53.name: Development
53.description: A cat crossing a series of stepping stones through a marsh at twilight, cranes painted on distant screens, each careful step part of a long migration, gradual progress.

54.name: The Marrying Maiden
54.description: A young cat entering a lantern-lit household garden at dusk, half welcomed and half uncertain, delicate social timing, position, and adaptation.

55.name: Abundance
55.description: A cat beneath a festival canopy of lanterns and summer flowers, everything bright, full, and briefly at its height, abundance with awareness of passing time.

56.name: The Wanderer
56.description: A traveling cat carrying a small cloth bundle along a mountain road at sunset, distant inn lights below, beauty and loneliness of temporary shelter.

57.name: The Gentle
57.description: A cat moving silently through tall bamboo as soft wind bends every stalk, influence entering gradually, persistence without force.

58.name: Joy
58.description: Two cats beside a moonlit lake, one paw touching the water while small bells ring in a breeze, shared delight, openness, and gentle communication.

59.name: Dispersion
59.description: A cat watching fog lift from a wide river as paper lanterns drift apart and rejoin currents, old hardness dissolving into movement.

60.name: Limitation
60.description: A cat arranging bamboo water cups along a garden channel, each cup filling only to its proper measure, boundaries, rhythm, and useful restraint.

61.name: Inner Truth
61.description: A cat resting beside an open birdcage under the moon, no chase, only trust and quiet listening, a soft golden glow at the heart.

62.name: Small Preponderance
62.description: A careful cat balancing tiny tea cups on a narrow shelf, every paw movement precise, modest attention making small things matter greatly.

63.name: After Completion
63.description: A cat crossing the final stone of a stream at dusk, looking back at perfectly placed pawprints as lantern light steadies, completion that still requires vigilance.

64.name: Before Completion
64.description: A cat paused before the last step across a dawn stream, one paw lifted, mist glowing on the far bank, almost there but not yet crossed.
